files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/deploy.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+: "${DEPLOY_TOKEN:?DEPLOY_TOKEN must be set}"
+: "${REGISTRY_URL:?REGISTRY_URL must be set}"
+# Credential transport: the token reaches curl via a private header
+# file (0600), never argv — /proc/<pid>/cmdline is observable on
+# shared runners.
+HDR="$(mktemp)"
+trap 'rm -f "$HDR"' EXIT
+( umask 077; printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s' "$DEPLOY_TOKEN" > "$HDR" )
+curl -sS -f -H @"$HDR" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  -d @payload.json "$REGISTRY_URL/deploy"

note: Globally clean: header-file credential transport (0600, single trap) — the audited safe pattern.
